paths.description: Homepage and primary news discovery surface; represents global header, navigation, hero carousel, and section feeds.
News listing archetype; represents section/list pages and repeated story cards.
News article/detail archetype; represents the primary content-reading journey and article metadata.
Topic index archetype; represents long browse/index surfaces.
Contact form journey; exercised empty submission to inspect labels, validation, and recovery without sending data.
English localized homepage; represents translated variants and the consent experience.
Unknown URL and recovery path; represents HTTP failure handling.
Login entry journey; exercised the login control and inspected the resulting authentication screen.

findings.summary: The site does not adapt to dark color preference.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-color-scheme: dark, the probe reports color-scheme: normal and body background rgb(255,255,255); the dark screenshot remains light.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens, using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: The auto-advancing hero continues animating when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, getAnimations() still reports a running 20,000 ms animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Stop carousel auto-advance and remove non-essential transitions inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: No high-contrast preference styling is present.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more probe matched the condition but found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast rules that preserve visible boundaries, focus indicators, and controls.

findings.summary: Carousel and route changes rely on abrupt or JavaScript-driven motion rather than preference-aware platform transitions.
findings.evidence: The feature probe found no authored view-transition CSS while the page uses a Slick carousel with 80 cloned slides and a running 20-second animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use progressive View Transitions for navigation where helpful and a native scroll-snap carousel, always respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: The mobile layout renders at roughly 744-780 CSS pixels and clips the right side.
findings.evidence: At a 360px visual viewport, layout measured scrollWidth 744 and horizontalOverflowPx 384. Home, listing, article, and form screenshots all show clipped desktop-width content.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the fixed/minimum 780px layout constraint, size grids intrinsically, allow navigation to collapse, and verify reflow at 320-400px and 200% zoom.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is absent on many primary links, and carousel clones remain focusable while aria-hidden.
findings.evidence: The focus probe reports outline none on primary navigation and story links. Lighthouse reports aria-hidden=true carousel slides containing focusable links.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible indicator and remove hidden carousel descendants from sequential focus until their slide is active.

findings.summary: Load performance misses the good LCP range and the page remains busy far too long.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.4s and TTI 18.8s; the trace measured LCP 4699ms. HAR transferred 7.25MB across 74 requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize and right-size the LCP image, reduce server/document latency, defer non-critical media and third parties, and split non-critical JavaScript.

findings.summary: The homepage ships substantial main-thread and unused code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 2.5s main-thread work, including 924ms script evaluation, and flags unused JavaScript and CSS; HAR records 27 script requests totaling about 1.01MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Use route/component code splitting, remove unused legacy/polyfill code, and load analytics and optional widgets after core content.

findings.summary: Images are not consistently dimensioned, responsive, or efficiently encoded.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 44/100 without dimensions, 57 without srcset, and 47 in legacy formats; Lighthouse also failed unsized-images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio, responsive srcset/sizes, and AVIF/WebP variants through the image pipeline.

findings.summary: Core browser security headers are absent and cookies use weak attributes.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but the headers audit found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. All five observed cookies lacked Secure and used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy; set Secure and an appropriate SameSite value on cookies.

findings.summary: Tracking is extensive and consent is inconsistent across locale entry points.
findings.evidence: The tracker audit saw 13 third-party origins and six known tracker domains. The Vietnamese fresh load starts trackers without a visible consent choice, while English is covered by a consent modal naming 210 partners.
findings.suggestedFix: Default optional analytics off until a clear consent choice, reduce vendors and data fields, and apply the same consent policy across locales.

findings.summary: The contact form lacks input metadata and gives weak empty-submission feedback.
findings.evidence: Inputs have empty name/autocomplete and required=false. Empty submission sets aria-invalid=true, but exposes no validation message or visible error text in the captured body.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required/type=email/name/autocomplete attributes, validate after interaction, show field-specific messages, and announce a linked error summary.

findings.summary: Localized metadata and the English consent layout are not fully adapted.
findings.evidence: The English page correctly sets lang=en, but keeps the Vietnamese document title. Its consent panel overflows the mobile viewport and clips controls/text.
findings.suggestedFix: Localize all metadata and test translated strings in fluid layouts; use logical properties and constrain dialogs to the visual viewport.

findings.summary: Authentication offers social/email-password entry but no visible phishing-resistant passkey path.
findings.evidence: The exercised login screen shows Google, Apple, and email entry; no passkey option is visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer discoverable passkey registration and authentication alongside account recovery, while retaining appropriate fallbacks.

findings.summary: Resource use is disproportionate for a news homepage.
findings.evidence: HAR transferred 7.25MB, including 3.58MB images and 1.95MB media, while the tracker probe found 13 third-party origins and the hero auto-animates.
findings.suggestedFix: Set template budgets, avoid autoplay/background media, defer non-essential third parties, and serve responsive modern images.

findings.summary: The homepage memory footprint is high for a content page.
findings.evidence: Heap summaries contain roughly 631k-641k nodes and 39.5-41.5MB self size; the DOM probe found 3,670 elements and 80 carousel slides.
findings.suggestedFix: Virtualize or remove cloned/offscreen content, limit carousel duplication, clear timers/listeners, and retest baseline-target-final heaps.

taskList.title: Fix true mobile reflow and translated dialog sizing
Reduce LCP, long-lived work, page weight, and memory footprint
Deploy security headers, secure cookies, and consent-gated analytics
Repair keyboard focus and carousel accessibility
Respect dark, reduced-motion, and contrast preferences
Make contact validation and autocomplete humane
